pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit sub-polygonal geometries with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Relative spatial area of patches increases from the upper-right to the center, where they become less defined due to low-light conditions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light pelage forms a topological graph with predominantly tri-radial junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively constant in visible sections, maintaining structural continuity across the observed flank surface.
